entry.name: mc.pack~
entry.digest: Combine single inputs into a multichannel signal
entry.description: The mc.pack~ object combines inputs (signals, multichannel signals, floats) into a multi-channel signal. Unlike mc.combine~, mc.pack~ creates an output multichannel signal that contains exactly the number of channels as its number of inlets.

arguments.name: size
arguments.digest: The number of inlets and output channels
arguments.description: The argument todetermines both the count of inlets and channels in its output multichannel signal.

attributes.name: chans
attributes.digest: Fixed channel count
attributes.description: If theattribute is set to a value smaller than the number of inlets of, extra channels will be removed from the multichannel output the next time the audio is restarted. By default, theattribute is set to 0, which means the output channel count is always equal to the number of inlets.
